name: Trocador Swype Mastercard
summary: International virtual prepaid Mastercard purchased via crypto. 3% + $2 issuance fee. $2.50/month fee after 2nd month. $0.75 fee per non-US purchase. ~2% FX fee. Load amounts: $10-$1000. No 3D Secure support. Cannot be used for US purchases.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Trocador Swype Mastercard charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$2.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Trocador Swype Mastercard?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
